expectation: Membranous honeycomb at lateral junctions of epithelial cells (with E-cadherin), lining crypts/glands of the mucosa; common in epithelium, absent from stroma/muscle; possibly nuclear in some tumour cells.
notes: bCAT outlines every epithelial cell membrane in the mucosal glands and crypts, and stroma and muscle are dark. The E-cadherin partner shows only haze and blobs, so row E can't confirm or refute it.
observed: A: bright in the gland-rich mucosa only; muscularis/serosa dark. B, C: crisp lateral membrane honeycomb in columnar epithelium, lamina propria dark. D: sharp membrane outlines. E: bCAT has rings; E-cadherin has no cell structure.
why: Sharp membranous honeycomb in the epithelium only, with dark stroma, is the expected junctional β-catenin pattern.
